export interface ContactMessage { name: string, email: string, message: string }
export type ContactErrors = Partial<Record<keyof ContactMessage, string>>

const emailPattern = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/

export function checkContact({ name, email, message }: ContactMessage): ContactErrors {
  const errors: ContactErrors = {}

  if (name.trim() === '')
    errors.name = 'Name is required.'

  if (email.trim() === '')
    errors.email = 'Email is required.'
  else if (!emailPattern.test(email.trim()))
    errors.email = 'Enter a valid email address.'

  if (message.trim().length < 20)
    errors.message = 'Message must be at least 20 characters.'

  return errors
}
EOF

cat > src/components/favorite-button.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { favorites } from '../favorites'

const { slug } = props<{ slug: string }>()
const isFavorite = memo(() => favorites().includes(slug))

function toggle() {
  favorites.set(list => list.includes(slug) ? list.filter(s => s !== slug) : [...list, slug])
}
---
button(type="button" onClick={toggle})
  if isFavorite
    | Remove from favorites
  else
    | Add to favorites
EOF
cat > src/components/book-list.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { favorites } from '../favorites'

interface Book { slug: string, title: string, author: string, year: number, tags: string[] }

const { books } = props<{ books: Book[] }>()
const tags = [...new Set(books.flatMap(book => book.tags))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b, 'en'))
const selected = signal<string | undefined>(undefined)
const shown = memo(() => {
  const tag = selected()
  return tag === undefined ? books : books.filter(book => book.tags.includes(tag))
})
---
div.filter(role="group" aria-label="Filter by tag")
  button(type="button" aria-pressed={selected === undefined ? 'true' : 'false'} onClick={() => selected.set(undefined)}) All
  for tag of tags key={tag}
    button(type="button" aria-pressed={selected === tag ? 'true' : 'false'} onClick={() => selected.set(tag)}) {tag}
ul(aria-label="Books")
  for book of shown key={book.slug}
    li
      a(href={`/books/${book.slug}`}) {book.title}
      | 
      span {book.author}, {book.year}
      if favorites().includes(book.slug)
        | 
        strong Favorite
EOF
